about.heading: About Me
about.description:
I’m a front-end developer who enjoys building and refining websites. Most of my work involves WordPress, BigCommerce and Shopify, with a focus on turning designs into responsive and functional user interfaces.
Outside of my day-to-day work, I use Nuxt and Tailwind CSS to explore different approaches to frontend development.
